targets.review_note: Assign score x by the parity of the number of set bits of x-1, with even parity assigned X so score1 belongs to X. The signed generating polynomial is the product over j=0..n-1 of(1-z^(2^j)), which has a zero of order n at z=1. Its first n power moments therefore vanish, including after shifting scores by1, proving equality for every polynomial of degree below n. Integer bit counts handle n up to60 without generating2^n scores.

targets.review_note: With maximum degree2 and no loops, each component is an isolated vertex, a simple path, a cycle of length>=3, or a two-vertex double-edge cycle. Exactly n-m components are paths, including isolated vertices. Their exponential generating function is A=x+(x^2+...+x^L)/2; cycles contribute B=x^2/2+sum(x^s/(2s),s=3..L). The bounded-size count is n!*[x^n]A^(n-m)/(n-m)!*exp(B). Remove the x^(n-m) factor, truncate to degree m, compute the path power by convolution and cycle coefficients from the logarithmic-derivative identity. Subtract bounds L and L-1 to enforce the maximum exactly, preserving the double-edge coefficient.
